privacy.description: This document explains how lvstants-portfolio.vercel.app collects, uses and protects your information when you visit.

sections.heading: Introduction
body: This website is the personal portfolio of Ly Van My (LVSTANTS). I respect your privacy and only collect the minimum data required for the website to function.

sections.heading: Data we collect
body: Depending on the features you use, the following data may be processed:
bullets: Contact form: name, email, subject and message that you voluntarily provide.
Language preference: stored in your browser localStorage to remember your VI/EN choice.
Camera (Hand gesture scroll): frames are processed entirely on your device with MediaPipe and are never recorded or uploaded.
Microphone (Voice assistant): only active when you enable it; speech is transcribed to text to handle your request.
Technical data: IP address and browser info may be temporarily logged by the hosting platform for security and anti-spam purposes.

sections.heading: How we use it
bullets: To reply to your messages and collaboration requests.
To improve the website experience and performance.
To prevent spam, abuse and harmful activity.
body: I do not sell, rent or share your personal data for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Third-party services
body: The website relies on some external services, each with its own privacy policy:
bullets: YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com): background music in privacy-enhanced mode.
jsDelivr / MediaPipe: loading the hand-gesture recognition library.
Email delivery service: forwarding contact form submissions.

sections.heading: Storage & security
body: Data is transmitted over HTTPS. Contact messages are kept only in my personal mailbox and deleted when no longer needed.
While reasonable measures are applied, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

sections.heading: Your rights
bullets: Request access to, correction or deletion of the data you submitted.
Revoke camera or microphone permissions at any time in your browser settings.
Clear localStorage data by clearing your browsing data.

sections.heading: Contact
body: For any privacy-related request, please email lyvanmy357@gmail.com or use the Contact page.

terms.description: Please read these terms carefully before using the website. Continued access means you accept these terms.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
body: By accessing and using this website, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please stop using the website.

body: All content including design, source code, logos, images and text is owned by Ly Van My unless otherwise noted.
Linked open-source projects are governed by the licenses published in their respective GitHub repositories.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
bullets: Copy or redistribute content for commercial purposes without permission.
Send spam, malware or unlawful content through the contact form.
Attack, scan for vulnerabilities or disrupt the operation of the website.

sections.heading: Third-party content
body: The website may contain links to or embedded content from third parties (GitHub, YouTube, LinkedIn...). I am not responsible for their content or policies.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
body: The website is provided "as is". Information is for reference only and may change without notice. Experimental features (hand gestures, AI voice) may not work reliably on every device.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
